native_original_tests_cumulative.scope: Ten focused groups; entire upstream suite not run.

public_save_failure_control.scope: Unmodified pinned SessionContext.save public API in a subprocess; per-child file size limit512 bytes, SIGXFSZ ignored; owned directory only

public_load_controls.scope: Original public from_json, four finite synthetic inputs; parser acceptance is not JSON/schema validation

findings: SessionContext.save ignores write_all failure and then renames the temporary file. With a per-child RLIMIT_FSIZE512-byte limit and ignored SIGXFSZ, a previous1472-byte valid JSON is replaced by512-byte invalid JSON; the unmodified public API returns normally and child exits0.
Public from_json accepts a truncated object containing call_counter7 and returns that counter. It is tolerant field extraction, not a strict whole-document JSON validity gate.
Legacy calls without sketches survive loading; mismatched parallel arrays are truncated to the shortest complete set. These are four finite controls, not exhaustive schema/fuzz qualification.
SessionContext.update explicitly fails open after250ms lock wait; save temp names are per-process rather than per-call. No concurrent timeout/thread race reproduced this turn.
transfer: No source adopted. Added rrrah regression proving pre-publication write failure preserves previous cache and retry.
limits: 17/327 complete manual file reviews; cache.rs remains partial.
File-size error control is in an owned child/directory only; no disk-full, power-loss or all-filesystem proof.
No host/plugin installation or actual MCP transport execution.
